knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A stain that returns after rain shows the source is still active. The job stays open with the source unresolved, a follow-up check is scheduled and an investigation is proposed for approval. Painting over the stain hides the cause, and payment does not resolve a defect.
Same-position photographs allow a fair comparison.
The lesson says to record the measurements, the materials used and the condition when the work ended.

passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Keep the issue open, attach conflicting evidence, seek clarification and schedule a documented reinspection.
Describe the responsible referral and documentary trail
stopWorkCriteria: Closing the fault or certifying quality without evidence.
